// permissions: defaultMode 'auto' runs a background classifier on every action. The lists below are the curated exceptions to that flow.

permissions.// allow: Hard-allowed: bypasses the auto-mode classifier entirely (no prompt, no check). Safe read-only / idempotent commands only.

sandbox.// excludedCommands: Run outside the sandbox from the start, for commands that reliably fail or misdetect inside it. Still auto-mode-classified unless also listed in permissions.allow above, in which case the hard-allow wins.

// env: AWS_VAULT_PROMPT=terminal turns any residual aws-vault GUI dialog into a terminal prompt that fails fast with no TTY, instead of blocking on a dialog.
// hooks: aws-sso-preflight blocks Bash commands that would resolve creds through an expired AWS SSO session, so credential_process can't hang on an interactive login. It also blocks bare `aws` commands with no profile selected (and no [default]), which would fail on missing creds, and tells Claude to re-run with a fitting profile (asking the user only if it's ambiguous).
